docs.text: Deepseek-Harness社区版计算巢部署文档 服务说明 Deepseek-Harness社区版是 DeepSeek AI 开源的 Agent Harness，提供浏览器 Web UI，可在页面中配置 DeepSeek 或 OpenAI 兼容模型，并选择工作区后运行代码代理任务。 当前版本为 DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 。相较于此前的 0.1.0-rc.6，主要功能与使用体验变化如下： 功能 更新内容 模型配置 自定义模型 API 支持在页面中设置各模型的推理等级；可配置输入类型、上下文窗口与最大输出 token 数，具体能力取决于所用模型。 自动化任务 自动化任务成为 Web 内置能力；提醒工具在标准、创造和 PTC 模式中可用，在极简模式和子代理中不可用。 插件管理 支持通过自定义插件索引源发现和安装插件；新增「让 Agent 创建插件」入口，发送需求后开始执行。 长对话与草稿 可用 /compact 指令手动压缩上下文；恢复草稿或切换工作区时保留文件、目录和会话引用。 消息展示 已发送消息中的密钥和令牌默认脱敏、按需查看；0.2.1-rc.5 优化了对话中思考内容的展示。 实验性扩展 提供 Git Worktrees、思考过程机器翻译和开发者工具插件，需在插件页按需安装或启用，不代表默认已开启。 Git Worktrees 插件可让 Agent 创建并进入独立的 Git checkout；思考过程翻译可选择 Bing、Google 或付费 DeepSeek Flash；开发者工具提供会话原始日志和调试入口。实验性功能可能随版本调整，使用前请查看对应插件说明。 详细变更见 0.2.1-rc.1 累积更新说明 与 0.2.1-rc.5 发布说明 。 服务实例部署流程 部署步骤 打开计算巢服务实例创建页面，选择部署地域并填写实例规格、实例密码和网络参数。 部署链接 确认询价明细后点击 下一步：确认订单 ，同意服务协议并点击 立即创建 。 等待服务实例部署完成。部署完成后，在服务实例详情页的 输出 区域查看 WebUIAddress 。 点击输出中的安全代理访问地址打开 Web UI。页面应展示 DeepSeek Harness 的新会话、设置和选择工作区入口。 首次使用配置 Deepseek Harness Web UI 打开后还不能直接发起会话，必须先完成模型和工作区配置。 1. 配置大模型 首次打开会弹出 开始使用 引导，点击 添加 API Key 可直接进入模型配置；也可以点击左下角 更多 → 设置 → 模型 。 在 模型 页签中，页面会列出 DeepSeek 提供方（ deepseek-official ）与「添加模型提供商」入口。 任选一种方式完成模型接入： 填写 DeepSeek API Key，使用 DeepSeek 官方模型。 点击 添加模型提供商 → 第三方模型提供商 ，从内置目录（OpenAI、Anthropic、Kimi、Qwen 等）中选择并填写 API Key。 点击 添加模型提供商 → 自定义模型 API ，填写 Base URL、API Key 与模型 ID。 新增提供商时点击 创建 ，编辑已有提供商时点击 保存 完成配置。 未配置模型 API Key 时，Web UI 可以打开，但无法正常发起模型请求。 示例：接入阿里云百炼 qwen-plus 在 设置 → 模型 中点击 添加模型提供商 → 自定义模型 API 。 填写以下配置。API Key 请使用您在百炼控制台申请的密钥，不要将密钥写入对话或公开文件。 字段 值 Provider ID bailian 显示名称 阿里云百炼 API 地址 https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 API 协议 OpenAI Chat Completions API 密钥 您自己的百炼 API Key 模型 ID qwen-plus 模型显示名称 Qwen Plus 添加上述模型后点击 创建 ；修改已有提供商时点击 保存 。 完成工作区选择后，在会话输入框的模型选择器中选择 Qwen Plus 。 该示例使用百炼中国内地兼容接口，请使用对应地域的 API Key。其他地域或网关请以提供商文档中的 API 地址和协议为准。保存配置或检测到凭据不代表模型调用已成功，需通过实际对话确认。 2. 选择工作区 返回主页面，点击 选择工作区 。 在目录选择器中进入 workspace ，点击 打开 。 工作区选择完成后，新会话输入框才可正常使用。 服务实例已在 ECS 上准备 /opt/deepseek-harness/workspace 作为默认工作目录，并在主目录下提供同名入口供目录选择器直接选取；DeepSeek Harness 的会话、凭据、存储和附件数据保存在 /opt/deepseek-harness/dsh-home 下。 3. 开始会话 确认工作区已选择，并在模型选择器中选择已配置的模型。 输入任务并发送，例如： 请概述当前工作区的目录结构，不要修改文件。 等待模型回复。只有收到实际回复，才说明模型鉴权和调用成功；若请求失败，请核对 API Key、API 地址、协议、模型 ID 及实例出网连接。 长对话需要压缩上下文时，可在输入框使用 /compact 指令。 运维说明 如需登录 ECS 排查服务状态，可使用实例密码远程连接 ECS 后执行： sudo systemctl status deepseek-harness.service sudo systemctl status nginx.service sudo journalctl -u deepseek-harness.service -n 100 --no-pager 服务启动脚本位于 /opt/deepseek-harness/bin/start-dsh-web ，应用日志位于 /opt/deepseek-harness/logs/service.log 。 注意事项 DeepSeek Harness 当前为 developer preview，上游未来版本可能存在破坏性变更。 用户在 Web UI 中配置的模型 API Key 会保存在服务实例本地持久化目录中，请妥善管理实例访问权限。 官方链接 DeepSeek Harness GitHub

docs.text: DeepSeek-Harness Community Edition ComputeNest Deployment Guide Service Overview DeepSeek-Harness Community Edition is an Agent Harness open-sourced by DeepSeek AI. It provides a browser-based Web UI where users can configure DeepSeek or OpenAI-compatible models, select a workspace, and run code agent tasks. The current version is DeepSeek Harness 0.2.1-rc.5 . Compared with the previous 0.1.0-rc.6 version, the main feature and usability changes are: Feature Updates Model configuration Custom model APIs support per-model reasoning levels in the UI. Input types, context windows, and maximum output tokens are configurable; actual capabilities depend on the model. Automation Automation tasks are built into the Web UI. Reminder tools are available in Standard, Creator, and PTC modes, but not in Minimal mode or subagents. Plugin management Discover and install plugins from custom plugin index sources. The new "Let Agent create a plugin" entry starts work after you send a request. Long conversations and drafts Use /compact to compress context manually. Restoring drafts or switching workspaces preserves file, folder, and session references. Message display Keys and tokens in sent messages are masked by default and can be revealed on demand. Version 0.2.1-rc.5 improves the display of thinking content. Experimental extensions Git Worktrees, reasoning translation, and Developer Tools plugins are available for on-demand installation or enablement on the Plugins page; they are not necessarily enabled by default. The Git Worktrees plugin lets the agent create and enter an independent Git checkout. Reasoning translation supports Bing, Google, or paid DeepSeek Flash. Developer Tools provides raw session logs and debugging tools. Experimental features may change between versions; read the corresponding plugin documentation before use. See the 0.2.1-rc.1 cumulative release notes and 0.2.1-rc.5 release notes for details. Service Instance Deployment Workflow Deployment Steps Open the ComputeNest service instance creation page. Select a region and fill in the instance type, instance password, and network parameters. Deployment Link After confirming the pricing details, click Next: Confirm Order . Accept the service agreement and click Create Now . Wait for the service instance deployment to complete. Once finished, check the WebUIAddress value in the Outputs section of the service instance details page. Click the Secure Proxy URL in the outputs to open the Web UI. The page should display the DeepSeek Harness new session, settings, and workspace selection entry points. Initial Configuration After opening the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, you cannot start a session immediately. You must first configure the model and workspace. 1. Configure the LLM Model The first visit shows a Getting started guide; click Add API Key to go straight to model configuration, or open More → Settings → Models from the lower-left corner. On the Models tab, the page lists the DeepSeek provider ( deepseek-official ) and an Add model provider entry. Pick one of the following to set up model access: Enter a DeepSeek API Key to use the official DeepSeek model. Click Add model provider → Third-party model provider and choose from the built-in catalog (OpenAI, Anthropic, Kimi, Qwen, and others), then enter the API Key. Click Add model provider → Custom model API and fill in the Base URL, API Key, and model ID. Click Create for a new provider or Save when editing an existing provider. Without a configured model API Key, the Web UI can still be opened, but model requests will not work. Example: Connect Alibaba Cloud Bailian qwen-plus Open Settings → Models → Add model provider → Custom model API . Enter the following settings. Use an API key obtained from the Bailian console; do not put the key in conversations or public files. Field Value Provider ID bailian Display name 阿里云百炼 API address https://dashscope.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1 API protocol OpenAI Chat Completions API key Your own Bailian API key Model ID qwen-plus Model display name Qwen Plus Add the model and click Create . When editing an existing provider, click Save . After selecting a workspace, choose Qwen Plus in the conversation's model selector. This example uses the Bailian compatible endpoint in the Chinese mainland; use an API key for that region. For other regions or gateways, follow the provider's documented API address and protocol. Saving settings or detecting credentials does not prove that model calls work; verify with an actual conversation. 2. Select a Workspace Return to the main page and click Select workspace . In the directory picker, enter workspace and click Open . Once a workspace is selected, the new session input box becomes functional. The service instance prepares /opt/deepseek-harness/workspace on the ECS as the default working directory and exposes it with the same name under the home directory so the directory picker can select it directly. DeepSeek Harness session data, credentials, storage, and attachments are stored under /opt/deepseek-harness/dsh-home . 3. Start a Conversation Confirm that a workspace is selected and choose a configured model in the model selector. Send a task, such as: Summarize the directory structure of the current workspace. Do not modify any files. Wait for an actual model response to confirm successful authentication and invocation. If the request fails, check the API key, API address, protocol, model ID, and the instance's outbound connectivity. Use /compact in the composer when you need to compress a long conversation's context. Operations & Maintenance To troubleshoot the service on the ECS, connect to the instance using the instance password and run: sudo systemctl status deepseek-harness.service sudo systemctl status nginx.service sudo journalctl -u deepseek-harness.service -n 100 --no-pager The service startup script is located at /opt/deepseek-harness/bin/start-dsh-web , and application logs are at /opt/deepseek-harness/logs/service.log . Important Notes DeepSeek Harness is currently in developer preview. Future upstream versions may introduce breaking changes. Model API Keys configured in the Web UI are stored in the service instance's local persistent directory. Please manage instance access permissions carefully. Official Links DeepSeek Harness GitHub
